UserDetails.title: UserDetails
UserDetails.description: User core profile including unique sequential userCode for authenticated accounts.

uid.description: Unique user ID from Firebase auth or local guest session.

email.description: Google email used for sign-in, or null for guests.

userCode.description: Sequentially generated unique identifier used as config key (e.g. UA000001, UB000001).

authProvider.description: Authentication provider used by the user.

adTier.description: True if user is on ad-free / lifetime pass tier, false for ad-supported tier.

SubscriptionPlan.title: SubscriptionPlan
SubscriptionPlan.description: Available Pro ad-free subscription plans with duration, original price, discounted price, and currency.

name.description: Human-friendly plan name (e.g., 1 Year Pro, Lifetime Pass).

badge.description: Optional badge label (e.g., POPULAR, BEST VALUE).

SubscriptionTransaction.title: SubscriptionTransaction
SubscriptionTransaction.description: Ledger of successful membership and pass purchase transactions.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the purchaser.

durationYears.description: Duration in years granted by this transaction.

planStartDate.description: ISO date string when the purchased period begins.

planEndDate.description: ISO date string when the purchased period expires.

paymentMethod.description: Payment gateway or billing channel used (e.g., google_play, apple_pay).

orderId.description: External payment gateway order reference ID.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the transaction was completed.

DeletedUserDetails.title: DeletedUserDetails
DeletedUserDetails.description: Archived user record stored upon account deletion to preserve membership tier and userCode upon reactivation.

UserConfig.title: UserConfig
UserConfig.description: Stores user configurations and global checklist keyed by userCode.

globalChecklist.description: Global checklist template across all travels.

UserTripcodeMaster.title: UserTripcodeMaster
UserTripcodeMaster.description: List of trip codes created by a specific user code.

tripCodes.description: List of 6-character trip codes created by this user.

TripMaster.title: TripMaster
TripMaster.description: Global directory mapping unique trip codes to their creator and edit permissions.

ownerUid.description: The Firebase UID of the user who created this trip.

allowOthersToModify.description: Whether other users or guests are allowed to modify this trip.

Trip.title: Trip
Trip.description: Full travel planner itinerary, companion log, expenses, and schedule details.

id.description: Unique random ID for the trip instance.

code.description: The 6-character alphanumeric share code and document ID.

checklist.description: Checklist specific to this trip instance (does NOT contain the global travel checklist).

TripGclistStyling.title: TripGclistStyling
TripGclistStyling.description: Dictionary keyed by tripCode storing copy of global checklist and trip styling JSON.

gclist.description: Copy of global checklist for this trip.

InboundMessage.title: InboundMessage
InboundMessage.description: Feedback, support, or contact messages submitted by users through the app.

IsResolved.description: Indicates whether the inbound message has been resolved.

Response.description: Support response message sent back to the user.

SeriesCodeCounter.title: SeriesCodeCounter
SeriesCodeCounter.description: Tracks the next available SERIES_CODE letter and SERIES_NUMBER for user code generation.

SERIES_CODE.description: The next available series code letter (e.g. 'A', 'B').

SERIES_NUMBER.description: The next available series sequence integer (1 to 999999).

/series_code/{id}.description: Global counter collection storing the next available SERIES_CODE and SERIES_NUMBER.

/users/{uid}.description: Collection of user identities and generated sequence codes.

/deleted_users/{uid}.description: Collection of soft-deleted user records to enable seamless account reactivation and license retention.

/user_configs/{userCode}.description: Collection of global checklist data indexed by userCode.

/user_tripcode_master/{userCode}.description: Collection mapping userCode to a list of tripCodes they have created.

/trip_master/{tripCode}.description: Dictionary of unique trip id and corresponding user id who created it and the edit permission flag.

/trips/{tripCode}.description: Main travel document containing schedules, expenses, and timeline, keyed by uppercase trip code.

/trip_gclist_styling/{tripCode}.description: Dictionary mapping tripCode to list of two JSONs: [copy of global checklist, trip styling JSON].

/inbound_messages/{messageId}.description: Collection of user feedback, contact us, and support inquiries.

/subscription_plans/{planId}.description: Configurable collection of available Pro membership tiers and pricing options.

/transactions/{transactionId}.description: Ledger of user plan purchases and membership billing transactions.
